   70  def stage_lr(step: int) -> float:
   71      if type(step) is not int or not 1 <= step <= 288:
   72          raise ValueError("Stage step must be one-based in 1..288")
   73      return 1e-5 * (step / 29 if step <= 29 else (288 - step) / 259)
